versions.changelog:
- Updated API endpoint in example code from api.heybossai.com to api.skillboss.co.
- No other changes; documentation and workflow remain the same.

Initial release of YouTube Summarizer.

- Automatically detects YouTube URLs and fetches video transcripts.
- Generates structured summaries with main thesis, key insights, notable points, and actionable takeaway.
- Provides video metadata (title, channel, views, date) and downloadable transcript files.
- Supports direct delivery of transcripts to Telegram channels; summary replies for other platforms.
- Includes error handling and fallback guidance if transcripts or metadata unavailable.
